chapter.heading: A Prayer for Divine Scrutiny and RedemptionA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Vindicate me,
O Lord,For I have walked in my integrity.I have also trusted in the Lord;I shall not slip. [2 Chr. 36:16; Prov. 6:15]

Examine me,
O Lord, and prove me;Try my mind and my heart. [Esth. 8:15; Prov. 28:12 c Esth.]

For Your
lovingkindness is before my eyes,And I have walked in Your truth.

I have
not sat with idolatrous mortals,Nor will I go in with hypocrites.

I have
hated the assembly of evildoers,And will not sit with the wicked.

I will
wash my hands in innocence;So I will go about Your altar, O Lord,

That I
may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving,And tell of all Your wondrous works. [Job 29:16; Ps. 41:1; Prov. 31:8,]

Lord, I
have loved the habitation of Your house,And the place where Your glory dwells. [Prov. 11:11]

Do not
gather my soul with sinners,Nor my life with bloodthirsty men, [Matt. 11:17]

In whose
hands is a sinister scheme,And whose right hand is full of bribes. [Gen. 4:5-8;]

But as
for me, I will walk in my integrity;Redeem me and be merciful to me. [Prov. 14:33]

My foot
stands in an even place;In the congregations I will bless the Lord.
